aboutIntro: MercyMed is a private outpatient medical centre in Bishkek. Our approach brings modern medical knowledge and international experience together with compassionate care.
aboutText: We care for the whole family in one place and aim to limit unnecessary investigations. Evidence-based medicine means using medical research to guide diagnosis and treatment, alongside the needs of each patient.
history: Mobile clinics in the regions of Kyrgyzstan.
The Bishkek clinic opened to continue and expand this work.
Local and international specialists care for families together.
outreach: Mobile clinics are at the heart of MercyMed. Teams travel to invited communities in the regions to provide consultations and medical support.
education: MercyMed provides training for doctors and medical students. Hospitals, medical schools and training partners can contact the clinic to discuss collaboration.
orgText: Yearly staff check-ups and special student arrangements for schools, companies and embassies. Discuss the needs of your organisation with the clinic.
teamIntro: Meet the ten team members listed in the client presentation, including our director, doula and physical therapist. Current roles, photographs and short biographies await clinic approval.
